Abstract

We report a 20+ year observational study of a single remarkable subject. Findings indicate a statistically improbable capacity for love, a research portfolio spanning functional MRI to raising two daughters without either one running off to join a circus, and a happiness metric that rises measurably whenever she is on-site. All effects below are significant, reproducible on demand, and, much to our relief, still ongoing.

This entire body of work has exactly one funding source, and it's you. Every good thing in this dataset: every festival, every flight taken just to be there, every photo where you somehow still show up smiling after doing everything for everyone else first, all of it has your fingerprints on it.

Thank you for being the calmest peer reviewer either of us will ever have, for asking about our lives before your own even on your own birthday, and for turning every ordinary Tuesday into something that felt like home. None of this gets cited enough. All of it is credited to you.

We love you more than any h-index could ever measure.

With love, Aashna & Aadya, on behalf of the entire research team (your family)
